PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The served device is mhs://localhost/openarm-unscrew, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R0. The model is the card's models[0], v2/openarm_mujoco_v2/unscrew_scene.xml, read in place from the pinned clone (never copied, imported, installed or modified). It attaches openarm_pedestal.xml, which attaches openarm_v20_bimanual.xml: 20 qpos and 20 dof, 17 position actuators (16 arm plus cap_lift_drive), timestep 0.002 s. The bridge derives action.ctrl's per-actuator bounds from the flattened model's ctrlranges (left arm openarm_v20_bimanual.xml:350-357, right arm :358-365, cap lift unscrew_scene.xml:82); the package writes no Limit of its own. The fake backend is fake.py, a callable stand-in mujoco module that parses the attachable model tree and integrates a placeholder first-order motion; because it is a callable module the gate warns G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND, and the family-derived inputs seed, ticks and action.ctrl[*] warn G8.NO_UNIT three times; these are the expected simulator-family warnings, and G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. The fake normalizes the double hyphen in the scene's first XML comment before ElementTree parses it; no model value changes. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's entry symbols are Gymnasium task environment classes (balance_residual_env.py:34, insert_env.py:41, pick_place_env.py:39, reach_env.py:35, balance_env.py:42), not MJCF files; the family-config MujocoDriver serves the card's models[0] as a raw simulated world, and the task environment's observations, reward, episode limits and controller logic are not served. NOT COVERED: MuJoCo was not installed and was never run; the fake computes no inertias, contacts, tendons, finger equalities or actuator dynamics, its trajectories are not MuJoCo results, and the engine's ctrl index order was not available to confirm (the stand-in inserts attached-model actuators at the attach element, yielding the 16 arm actuators then cap_lift); the v2/openarm_mujoco_v2/assets meshes and textures are not loaded; cap.world.reset.v1 calls mj_resetData and does not apply the ready keyframe; no rendering, cameras or sensor streams are served; the stand-in snapshot covers time, qpos, qvel and ctrl only; no physical OpenArm is modelled or controlled and no hardware run is claimed. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null).
